products.name: Sacred Ganesha Madhubani Painting
products.description: An authentic Madhubani masterpiece from Bihar, handcrafted with natural dyes. This painting depicts Lord Ganesha surrounded by intricate floral motifs, representing prosperity and wisdom.

products.name: Royal Tanjore Saraswati Art
products.description: Exquisite Tanjore painting with 24-carat gold foil and semi-precious stones. This divine depiction of Goddess Saraswati is a symbol of knowledge and music.

products.name: Odisha Pattachitra: Tree of Life
products.description: A stunning Pattachitra scroll painting on cloth, detailing the interconnectedness of all beings through the 'Tree of Life'.

products.name: Kalamkari Hand-Painted Lotus
products.description: A traditional Kalamkari artwork featuring hand-painted lotus flowers in earth tones using vegetable dyes on cotton fabric.

products.name: Mithila Peacocks Canvas
products.description: Vibrant Madhubani painting featuring a pair of peacocks, symbolizing eternal love and beauty. Handcrafted on fine canvas.

products.name: Golden Krishna Tanjore Art
products.description: Lord Krishna depicted in his childhood form, adorned with genuine gold leaf and sparkling stones. A royal Tamil Nadu tradition.

products.name: Warli Tribal Life Mural
products.description: Authentic Warli art from Maharashtra, painted with white pigment on a terracotta background, depicting the daily rhythm of tribal life.

products.name: Kangra Valley Miniature
products.description: An exquisite miniature painting from the Himachal foothills, known for its soft colors and lyrical portrayal of romantic themes.

profile.name: Artisan Ravi
profile.story: I am a folk artist dedicated to preserving the ancient art of Madhubani.
